pass_2.finding: Independent vendor read: FC-121-4001 is LT Set A with 12 indexed adapter tubes AD002/004/005/006/007/012/013/014/015/016/018/019. Table 12 prints a six-cycle index plus a seventh adjacent base for each; guide explicitly says seventh base is excluded from Index Read. CirSeq original names kit but no chosen member. Guide revision postdates paper and cannot establish study-specific member.

missing_claims.claim: Exact CirSeq selected TruSeq index member is confirmed unavailable
missing_claims.evidence: Original protocol names FC-121-4001 but does not assign a Set A member. The vendor guide enumerates twelve six-base possibilities. Original 2014 predecessor and supplement are still unavailable, and new sources await independent second check.

conclusion: Original, author manuscript and Illumina Nano guide now have two reads. The guide identifies FC-121-4001 as LT Set A and its 12 possible six-cycle index tags, but the selected CirSeq member remains blocked because the original predecessor article/supplement is inaccessible.
